original_test_intent: Validate either the BMC BIOS-configuration import function or, if engineering confirms the body is authoritative, the BMC Configure edit-and-apply persistence path: one approved reversible non-default setting must be applied, survive the required immediate reboot, OS load and second reboot, and remain visible in BIOS Setup without unrelated changes.
original_method: Select the unique row; resolve import-file versus direct-setting scope; identify SUT/BMC/BIOS firmware and export the complete baseline configuration; choose one low-risk reversible dependency-free setting and before/target/restore value; if import is required, create and checksum a minimal schema-valid config artifact containing only that delta; stage it through the approved BMC page; review the exact diff; quiesce workloads and authorize Reboot Host Immediately; capture apply job, boot, OS readiness and second reboot; enter BIOS Setup through KVM/operator, verify the value and no unrelated delta, then restore and verify the original configuration.
manual_activity: An engineer selects the reversible setting/import artifact and approves both reboots; an authorized operator verifies BIOS Setup and owns KVM/physical/CMOS recovery.
required_inputs: Decision whether title's configuration import or procedure's direct BMC edit is authoritative
SUT/BMC/BIOS/OS firmware and supported Redfish/WebUI BIOS-config schema/workflow
Approved low-risk setting path, current/default/target/restore values and dependencies
If import: minimal configuration file version/hash/schema and expected diff
Immediate reboot plus OS-load plus second-reboot timing/readiness, final state and recovery
safety_requirements: Never choose a random BIOS setting; avoid security, boot-device, memory-training, power or remote-access-critical values unless explicitly required
Export/backup the complete configuration and review the staged diff before apply
Drain jobs/users and confirm console/KVM recovery before Reboot Host Immediately
Verify each boot reaches expected readiness before the next transition
Stop on unexpected diff, apply failure, boot timeout/loop, lost BMC/KVM, setting dependency conflict or hardware error; no automatic reboot/reapply
agent_execution_scope: Validate identity, scope, setting/artifact, diff, approval and recovery
Collect BMC apply/job, boot/readiness, OS and configuration evidence
Assist the approved WebUI/import action only after separate execution confirmation
Do not choose random values, create broad imports, trigger reboot autonomously, alter unrelated settings, clear logs, repeat apply/reboot or decide verdict

Approve reboot sequence, persistence oracle, restore and recovery
Review diff/persistence/evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an immutable single-delta config artifact or explicitly approved direct edit, review the staged diff, run the two defined boots, verify persistence and restore from backup.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title requires an Import BIOS config page, but the Procedure describes direct WebUI editing of a random setting and never selects, uploads or validates a configuration file. Evidence for one path cannot automatically satisfy the other.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Both candidate workflows and the persistence purpose are identifiable. Engineering can resolve the authoritative path and supply the setting/artifact; static review completes with execution gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2222 Wistron-BMC Sanity-00005-V001: decide whether authoritative coverage is an actual BIOS configuration-file import or direct BMC Configure edit (or separate cases); approve SUT/BMC/BIOS/OS support, one low-risk setting path/current/default/target/restore and dependencies, minimal file schema/version/hash and expected diff if importing, exact immediate-reboot/OS-load/second-reboot readiness sequence, persistence/no-unrelated-change oracle, backup, final state, stop conditions and KVM/console/CMOS recovery.

review_improvement: Exposes the missing import operation, eliminates random BIOS mutation and makes one minimal configuration delta traceable through staging, two boots, BIOS verification and restoration.
independent_technical_reasoning: An import feature validates artifact parsing, schema, staging and diff application; directly editing a field exercises a different path. The source conflates them, so silently following either would create coverage regression. A random setting is also unsafe because BIOS options have hidden dependencies and some can break boot or remote recovery. The smallest valid test is a reviewed single reversible delta with full backup and diff evidence. Two separate readiness checkpoints are required because the source explicitly loads the OS and reboots again before BIOS verification.
